display.purpose: The home hero headline only. One per site.

title.purpose: Card headings and the footer brand mark.

lead.purpose: Hero subheading and section standfirsts, capped near 34rem.

label.purpose: Uppercase section kickers and footer column headings.

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Default raised card. Zero blur — the sticker lift.

shadows.name: pop-sm
shadows.purpose: Diagonal variant for smaller or tilted surfaces: FAQ accordions, story items.

shadows.name: pop-sheet
shadows.purpose: Mobile nav sheet and the flavour-of-the-week banner.

shadows.name: soft
shadows.purpose: The only ambient shadow. Dark story card and CTA banner exclusively.

motion.name: ease-bounce
motion.purpose: Default easing. Overshoots so elements read as having weight.

motion.name: ambient
motion.purpose: Blob morph, Ken Burns photo drift, badge rotation. Slow enough to ignore.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main call to action. Presses into the page when clicked.
components.html: 🍨 See the flavours
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; text-decoration: none; padding: 15px 30px; border-radius: 999px; border: 3px solid #3A2318; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #3A2318; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), box-shadow 0.25s; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #FF5D8F; color: #3A2318; } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 10px 0 #3A2318; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #3A2318; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8C5BD8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Same physics, white fill.
components.html: 📍 Find the Hut
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; text-decoration: none; padding: 15px 30px; border-radius: 999px; border: 3px solid #3A2318; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #3A2318; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), box-shadow 0.25s; } .ds-btn-ghost { background: #fff; color: #3A2318; } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 10px 0 #3A2318; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #3A2318; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8C5BD8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The core raised surface: outlined, hard-shadowed, white on mint.
components.html:
Sea Salt Caramel Fudge

Vanilla loaded with fudge chunks and a salty caramel swirl.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 3px solid #3A2318; border-radius: 24px; padding: 30px; box-shadow: 0 8px 0 rgba(58,35,24,0.9); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); max-width: 320px; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px) rotate(-0.6deg); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Shrikhand, cursive; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1.12; margin: 0 0 6px; color: #3A2318; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.45; color: #6B4630; margin: 0; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Header link with a pill hit-area; the current page fills solid pink.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-nav a { font-family: Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; color: #3A2318; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; transition: background 0.25s, transform 0.25s; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: #FFD3E1; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { background: #FF5D8F; color: #3A2318; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8C5BD8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Live open/closed indicator. The dot pulses only because the data is genuinely live.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.85rem; background: #3A2318; color: #EFFAF5; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: #62D98A; animation: ds-pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(98,217,138,0.7); } 55% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px rgba(98,217,138,0); } }

components.name: Dietary Chip
components.description: Factual dietary tag on the flavour glossary. Only shown when the shop publishes it.
components.css: .ds-chip-diet { display: inline-block; font-family: Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; background: #C9F2E9; color: #3A2318; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 8px; vertical-align: middle; }

components.name: Favourite Chip
components.description: Emphatic menu flag, e.g. 'for dogs!' or '3 flavours!'.
components.css: .ds-chip-fav { display: inline-block; font-family: Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; background: #FFAE52; color: #3A2318; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 9px; vertical-align: middle; }

components.name: Section Kicker
components.description: Uppercase Cherry label that sits above every section headline.
components.html:
The good stuff

Flavours worth the drive
components.css: .ds-kicker { font-family: Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 3px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #A81E52; margin: 0 0 10px; } .ds-headline { font-family: Shrikhand, cursive; font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.4rem); line-height: 1.12; color: #3A2318; margin: 0; }

components.name: Menu Row
components.description: Dotted-leader price row used throughout the menu.
components.css: .ds-menu-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; padding: 9px 0; border-bottom: 2px dashed #DCF3E9; font-family: Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; color: #3A2318; } .ds-dots { flex: 1; border-bottom: 2px dotted rgba(58,35,24,0.25); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-price { font-weight: 700; color: #A81E52; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-fav { display: inline-block; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; background: #FFAE52; color: #3A2318; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 9px; }

narrative.overview:
Everything in this system behaves like a die-cut vinyl sticker pressed onto a sheet of mint paper. Surfaces are outlined in a thick chocolate ink line, they cast a hard shadow with no blur at all, and they sit on the page rather than floating above it. Nothing is glassy, nothing is misty, nothing fades into its background. The world is legible from across a parking lot, which is roughly the viewing distance this business actually operates at.

The palette is a confectionery one — pink, mint, caramel, berry — but it is disciplined by a single dark brown that does all the structural work: every border, every shadow, every piece of body text. That brown is what stops the brightness from turning into noise. The type pairing runs the same way: Shrikhand carries all the personality in headings and does none of the reading work, while Fredoka handles every sentence in a plain, friendly, high-legibility voice.

The register is playful but never childish, and never precious. This is a thirty-year-old family business whose defining trait is that the portions are absurd; the design should feel generous and confident in the same way. Motion overshoots slightly on interaction — things bounce back like they have weight — but nothing loops forever demanding attention.
keyCharacteristics: Hard-edged: 3px ink outlines and zero-blur offset shadows on every raised surface
Bright but anchored: five candy hues held together by one structural brown
Pill-shaped interactivity: anything clickable is fully rounded
Display type for personality, body type for everything you actually read
Motion with overshoot and weight, never ambient drift

rules.name: The Two Pinks Rule
rules.body: Bubblegum fills, Cherry writes. #FF5D8F may back a shape but must never be the colour of text on a light surface; #A81E52 is the accent text colour and should not be used as a large fill. Every text-on-background pair in this system clears WCAG AA (4.5:1), and this split is how that stays true.

rules.name: The One Brown Rule
rules.body: Borders, shadows, and body copy are all Chocolate Ink. Do not introduce a second neutral, a grey, or a pure black. Depth and structure come from one colour used consistently.

rules.name: The Shrikhand Ceiling Rule
rules.body: The display face is for headings, the brand mark, and large numerals. It never sets a paragraph, a label, a button, or a menu row. It has one weight and no italic — if a design needs emphasis inside display type, change the size or the colour, not the weight.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional text — chips, labels, prices, captions, nav — renders below 11px at any viewport. Decorative micro-labels are still functional and are still in scope.

rules.name: The Zero-Blur Rule
rules.body: Raised surfaces cast a hard offset shadow with a blur radius of 0. If a new component needs a soft glow to look right, the component is wrong for this system — not the rule.

rules.name: The Ink Outline Rule
rules.body: Every raised surface carries a 3px solid Chocolate Ink border (4px on hero media and the story photo). There are no borderless cards. The outline and the hard shadow are a matched pair; never ship one without the other.

dos: Do pair every 3px Chocolate Ink outline with a zero-blur Pop shadow.
Do use pink for fills and pink-deep for accent text — the Two Pinks Rule keeps the whole system at WCAG AA.
Do make anything clickable a 999px pill.
Do animate transform and opacity only. Buttons and cards move; layout boxes do not.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion — the reduced-motion block neutralises every animation and reveals all scroll-hidden content.
Do keep display type (Shrikhand) out of body copy, buttons, and labels.
donts: Don't apply a gradient to text via background-clip: text. It was removed from the hero deliberately; the wavy caramel underline replaced it.
Don't add a coloured stripe along one edge of a card. Removed from the flavour cards on purpose.
Don't build an infinitely auto-scrolling marquee. The facts strip is a static wrapping row, and that was a deliberate downgrade from a ticker.
Don't animate padding, width, height, or margin. The header's padding transition was removed for exactly this reason.
Don't introduce grey, pure black, or a second neutral. One brown does all structural work.
Don't put a pulsing dot on anything that isn't reporting genuinely live, changing data.
Don't let functional text fall below 11px, including inside the footer.
Don't use a soft/blurred shadow on a light surface — that shadow belongs only to the dark story card and CTA banner.
